component.name: Easel
component.summary: A simple paint program in the spirit of classic Paint

description.p: Easel is a native GNOME paint program with the functionality and workflow of the old Microsoft Paint of Windows XP, built with GTK 4 and libadwaita.

ul.li: All the classic tools: pencil, brush, airbrush, eraser, fill, text, line, curve, shapes and selections
Unlimited-step undo and redo, zoom, pixel grid and thumbnail
Open and save PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF and WebP
Light and dark style, keyboard shortcuts, Preferences
